# pangolin_client_role (Resource)

Gives a role to a machine client (`pangolin_client`, Pangolin 1.24+, Enterprise): the client gets the private resources (`pangolin_site_resource`) assigned to the role, instead of binding it to each one with `pangolin_site_resource_client`. Cumulative: other roles of the client are kept. Clients owned by a user cannot hold roles, they inherit their user's.

> **Note:** Both attributes are `RequiresReplace`: the binding is identified by its `(client_id, role_id)` pair.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "pangolin_role" "ci" {
  name = "ci"
}

resource "pangolin_client" "ci_runner" {
  name = "ci-runner"
}

# The CI runner reaches every private resource given to the "ci" role.
resource "pangolin_client_role" "ci_runner" {
  client_id = pangolin_client.ci_runner.id
  role_id   = pangolin_role.ci.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `client_id` (Number) The numeric ID of the machine client (`pangolin_client.id`).
- `role_id` (Number) The numeric ID of the role.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import a client/role binding as {client_id}/{role_id}.
terraform import pangolin_client_role.ci_runner 12/3
```
